 Penguins at Kings projected lineups
 By 
 NHL.com 
 @NHLMedia 
 November 07, 2026 
 Link copied 
 PENGUINS (5-9-2) at KINGS (5-7-2) 
 9 p.m. ET; ABTV, SN-PIT 
 Penguins projected lineup 
 Rickard Rakell -- Sidney Crosby -- Evgeni Malkin
 Tommy Novak -- Ben Kindel -- Egor Chinakhov
 Ville Koivunen -- Hendrix Lapierre -- Justin Brazeau
 Connor Dewar -- Blake Lizotte -- Nick Robertson
 Spencer Stastney -- Erik Karlsson
 Samuel Girard -- Kaedan Korczak
 Declan Carlile -- Kris Letang
 Sergei Murashov
 Arturs Silovs
 Scratched: Jake Livanavage, Ilya Solovyov, Andrei Kuzmenko 
 Injured: Ryan Graves (knee), Trevor van Riemsdyk (lower body), Bryan Rust (lower body), Elmer Soderblom (upper body) 
 Kings projected lineup 
 Artemi Panarin -- Alex Laferriere -- Adrian Kempe
 Trevor Moore -- Quinton Byfield -- Corey Perry
 Andre Lee -- Scott Laughton -- Alex Turcotte
 Erik Haula -- Kenny Connors -- Joel Armia
 Erik Gustafsson -- Brandt Clarke
 Joel Edmundson -- Drew Doughty
 Mikey Anderson -- Brian Dumoulin
 Darcy Kuemper
 Anton Forsberg
 Scratched: Cody Ceci, Samuel Helenius, Martin Chromiak 
 Injured: Kevin Fiala (leg surgery), Mats Zuccarello (upper body) 
 Status report 
 Malkin moved up to the first line with Crosby and Rakell at Pittsburgh’s morning skate. … Van Riemsdyk, a defenseman, traveled with the Penguins for their three-game California road trip. He was on the ice for the morning skate but will miss his 11th straight game. … Turcotte will return after missing 11 games because of an undisclosed injury. It will be his first game since Oct. 6.
